[[File:Draag_orders_Guineo.jpg|thumb|left|A Guineo underling and the Draag supervisor]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], a [[Draag]] '''supervisor''' worked in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of [[Haugg Nerf Industries]] in the [[Industrial District/Legends|industrial district]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. One day, when a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] that belonged to a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Death stick/Legends|death stick]] dealer named [[Jervis Gloom]] arrived without Gloom on it, the Draag suspected something unusual had happened. The [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] told a [[Guineo]] [[Unidentified Guineo guard|lackey]] to guard the speeder, and the Draag left to inform the factory's boss, [[Groff Haugg]]. Before the Draag could do so, however, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] intervened.
